observations: Photo 0 shows a black projector from a top-down angle.
The brand 'EPSON' is clearly visible in white letters on the top surface.
Model 'EB-S02' is printed on the right side of the control panel.
There is a control panel with buttons: Help, Esc, Menu, Source Select, Power, Lamp Temp, and navigation arrows.
A lens cover is visible on the left side, with an 'Open' arrow indicating its position.
There are multiple warning and caution labels in English and French.
A sticker says 'SOLD/SERVICED BY MEGAPROJECTORS' with a phone number.
The surface shows some minor scuffs and wear, especially near the lens cover and edges.
The projector is placed on a tiled floor, likely indoors.

claims.claim: This is a versatile and flexible projector that makes presentation easy and effective.
claims.evidence: The claim about versatility and effectiveness cannot be verified from the photo alone; it requires functional testing or user experience.

risks.risk: The projector may not power on or project an image.
risks.proof: A video showing the projector turning on, displaying a test image or connected to a device.

risks.risk: The lamp may be burnt out or nearing end of life.
risks.proof: A close-up of the lamp status indicator or a video showing the lamp light during operation.

risks.risk: The lens or internal optics may be dirty or damaged, affecting image quality.
risks.proof: A close-up of the lens and a video of the projected image on a screen.

risks.risk: The projector may have physical damage not visible in the photo, such as cracked casing or broken buttons.
risks.proof: A 360-degree video or multiple close-up photos showing all sides and buttons.

proof_requests: Video of the projector turning on and projecting an image.
Close-up of the lamp indicator and lens condition.
Photos or video showing all sides and buttons in working condition.
Confirmation of included accessories (remote, cables, etc.).
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an Epson EB-S02 projector. While functional claims are unverifiable remotely, the physical condition is visible and shows minor wear. The risks are listed and priced at their worst case until proven otherwise.
